name: apple-design-language
description: Unofficial, HIG-researched design system for AI agents building apps across the Apple ecosystem (iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo, Mac, Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro, Apple Watch) in SwiftUI, React, Next.js, HTML + CSS, Tailwind CSS, Vue, Svelte, or React Native: guidelines, 245 rules with IDs, a skill with verified recipes and design tokens for every stack, and hooks that check edited UI files. Created by Edison Augustin X.
